analogy.rationale: Tubulin polymerization inhibitors cause mitotic spindle disruption and mitotic arrest, a downstream program shared with other microtubule-targeting and mitotic kinase inhibitors. Aurora, PLK, and CDK inhibitors also converge on mitotic arrest, though less directly than microtubule inhibitors.
